name: kornia
description: 🐍 Geometric Computer Vision Library for Spatial AI
one_liner: A toolbox of computer-vision building blocks (image rotation, feature detection, 3D geometry) that developers plug into their own AI software — not something a non-coder would ever touch directly.
buyer: This is a developer library, not a product. Its 'buyer' is an engineer building something else, who saves build time by not writing this math themselves.
business_use_cases: A robotics or drone startup uses it as the geometry/vision backbone for an obstacle-avoidance feature instead of writing it from scratch.
An AR/VR company uses its camera-model and depth tools inside a larger product's tracking pipeline.

money_ideas.idea: No direct monetization of the library itself — value only shows up in a product built on top of it.

steal_this: Not a weekend-business material on its own — honest take: this is infrastructure for other builders, worth a low rating as a standalone opportunity.
